title: SAAM Operation Manifest
description: Describes one machine-neutral additive-manufacturing operation (skill). This schema validates each operation's manifest.json.

manifestSchemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest schema itself, not the operation's own version.

id.description: The operation's permanent identity. Referenced by process plans, dependency lists, and the registry. Never changes, even if the operation is renamed, redisplayed, or moved to a different directory.

version.description: Semantic version of this operation's own behavior, independent of manifestSchemaVersion.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Free to change without affecting `id` references.

category.description: Freely reorganizable classification tags (for example, ["additive", "planar"]). Category is metadata for browsing and the registry, never an operation's identity or a dependency reference target — use `id` for that. Recategorizing an operation is a metadata edit, not a breaking change.

capabilityRequirements.description: Machine capabilities this operation needs to be resolved, as data rather than as a naming prefix (e.g. do not encode capability into `id`). A machine definition is compatible with this operation only if it declares every listed capability.

maturity.description: concept: proposed or partially implemented, not yet demonstrated end-to-end. experimental: runs deterministically and passes its own tests, not yet evidenced on physical hardware. validated: has at least one ROBOT-CONFIRMED evidence record. This is independent of the `evidence` field below, which records the specific supporting claim(s).

scope.description: The exact machine, tool, material, and configuration the label applies to. Required whenever label is ROBOT-CONFIRMED or KNOWN FAILURE.

reference.description: Path or URL to the supporting record.

inputs.description: A JSON Schema object describing this operation's own parameters (its `parameters` shape inside a process-plan operation invocation).

outputs.description: Describes what this operation produces: part-spec fields it can set, and the toolpath path `family` names it emits.

dependencies.description: Operation `id`s this operation is designed to compose after (for example, a cladding operation depending on a support-scaffold operation). Not a version constraint — just a composition relationship.

module.description: Path to the generator module, relative to the operation's own directory.

deterministic.description: SAAM operations must be deterministic: identical inputs (including process settings and machine profile) always produce identical output.

validation.description: Rules this operation's output is checked against before it can be included in a process plan (e.g. bounds, continuity, tool-state transitions).

examples.description: Paths to example invocations and their expected output fixtures, used by tests/golden.
